test.description: Hillshade in the built-in identity projection. One Grand Canyon DEM tile is served for every tile id, and the 256px view at zoom 11 sits inside tile 12/758/100 of the identity grid, lng -56.7 and lat 85.6, near the top of the world square. The identity CRS's units count as meters, so its zoom 0 world is 180 m wide; the custom encoding is the mapbox one scaled by 180/40075016.69, which puts the elevations in those units, and the relief shades as the same tile does in mercator at the equator. With the mercator world width in the slopes instead, the relief would be 222639 times flatter, and under mercator's latitude correction that tile row is 85N, every slope divided by cos(85), so the same view would saturate into near-black shadows and white highlights.
